novel_features.name: Result-Set Drift Detector
novel_features.description: Compares URL result sets for a query across two sync dates to surface what appeared, disappeared, or persisted between runs.

novel_features.name: Cross-Query Entity Co-occurrence
novel_features.description: Extracts named entities from locally stored result text and ranks which entities co-appear most frequently across multiple queries.

novel_features.name: Monitor Delivery Digest
novel_features.description: Aggregates locally-logged monitor delivery events into a weekly roll-up showing which monitors fired, how often, and what URLs they returned.

novel_features.name: URL Discovery Velocity
novel_features.description: Counts net-new URLs discovered per time bucket across successive syncs to visualize how fast a topic is being covered.

novel_features.name: Answer Contradiction Finder
novel_features.description: Fires two /answer calls for the same question using different search strategies (auto vs keyword) and diffs their sentences to surface contradictory claims.

novel_features.name: Reusable Query Templates
novel_features.description: Save parameterized query templates with {{variable}} interpolation, then run them by name — no re-typing flags on recurring research workflows.

novel_features.name: Spend Budget Tracker
novel_features.description: Set a daily spend ceiling (in cents) and track estimated API spend per command so you never accidentally burn through your Exa quota.

novel_features.name: Cross-Search URL Intersection
novel_features.description: SQL JOIN across stored search results to find URLs that appear in two or more distinct queries — surfaces the most-cited sources across a research session.
